label: Stripe
description: Stripe API keys: live and test mode secret keys, restricted keys, and publishable keys.

signals.reason: A live secret key (sk_live_) acts on real payments with full access. A charge, a refund, or a payout cannot be undone.
A live restricted key (rk_live_) acts on real payments. Its permissions come from the Stripe dashboard, so Apassy does not suggest the scope.
A test mode secret key (sk_test_) reaches test data only. It moves no real money.
A test mode restricted key (rk_test_) reaches test data only. Its permissions come from the Stripe dashboard.
A publishable key (pk_live_) is public in the browser. It can only collect payment details for a token.
A test mode publishable key (pk_test_) is public and reaches test data only.
The item name or a label names Stripe.
A host of the item is a Stripe host.
